messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rohan yaar, aaj teen deadlines ek hi din aa gayi, poora din headset laga ke baitha, sar dard kar raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Bhai tu roz subah nau se raat gyarah kaam kar raha hai, yeh koi tareeka hai? Sabse pehle ek chai le aur do minute shaant baith.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Shaant kaise baithu, manager ne bola release Friday hai, aur mera part adhoora pada hai. Kal raat do baje tak kiya, phir bhi kuch nahi bana.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Mera bhi pehle wahi haal tha, teen mahine continuous overtime ke baad main burnout ke kinare pahunch gaya tha, phir maine apni tasalli ke liye roz ek chhota walk shuru kiya.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Walk? Idhar toh baahar nikalne ka time bhi nahi hai. Ghar par bhi sab poochte rehte hain ki shaadi kab kar raha hai, upar se yeh project.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Dekh, kaam aur ghar dono ka bojh ek saath uthana namumkin hai. Aaj raat sirf ek kaam khatam kar, baaki kal ki subah dekh. Poori list ek din mein nahi hoti.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sahi keh raha hai, main sab kuch ek saath sochke aur dar jata hoon. Manager ko bolunga ki Friday sirf core part milega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, aur yeh bhi bol dena ki extra time chahiye, warna wahi cycle chalti rahegi. Main bhi seekha tha ki mana karna kaam chhorne se alag hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tune toh kaha tha ki tu bhi burnout ke paas gaya tha, woh kaise sambhala?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Maine apne senior se khul ke baat ki, wo bhi shocked tha ki main itna load le raha hoon. Usne do projects mere paas se hata diye. Uske baad main thoda normal hua.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Yeh toh helpful hai, mujhe lagta tha sirf main hi struggle kar raha hoon. Tera sach bolne se himmat mili.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Aur ek cheez, maine apne liye ek rule banaya, raat das baje ke baad laptop band. Pehle do hafte mushkil lage, phir neend wapas aa gayi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Chalo, aaj se yeh try karta hoon. Aur kal manager se baat bhi karta hoon. Thanks yaar, sach mein halka lag raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Kabhi bhi bata dena, main yahi hoon. Aur agar Friday tak pressure badhe toh mujhe message kar, main code review mein help kar dunga.

questions.answer_quote: teen deadlines ek hi din aa gayi

questions.answer_quote: main burnout ke kinare pahunch gaya tha

questions.answer_quote: teen mahine continuous overtime ke baad

questions.query: Usne apni dincharya mein kaunsi nayi aadat daali thi?
questions.answer_quote: raat das baje ke baad laptop band

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rohan, result aa gaya, mera entrance exam clear nahi hua, cutoff se sirf char marks neeche reh gaya. Ghar walon ko kaise batau?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Arre yaar, char marks ka gap matlab knowledge kam nahi, sirf ek din ka bad luck. Tu ek saal ki mehnat ko ek number se nahi tol sakta.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Par mummy ne poora saal mere liye pooja ki, papa ne coaching ki fees bhari. Ab sab bekaar lagega.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Maine bhi apna pehla attempt miss kiya tha, poora mahina main ghar se baahar nahi gaya, khud ko hi kos raha tha. Aaj wahi paper maine clear kiya hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sach? Tujhe kaise pata tha ki dobara try karna chahiye? Main toh ab soch raha hoon ki chhod dun.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ek raat maine apne papa ko sab bata diya, wo roye nahi, bas bole ki tu phir se padh. Us din samajh aaya ki result se zyada koshish matter karti hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mere papa toh bahut strict hain, unko sunte hi gussa aa jayega. Main darti hoon ki woh kya sochenge.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Unhe blame mat kar, woh bhi pressure mein hain. Pehle sirf facts bata, phir apna plan bata, ki next attempt ke liye taiyar hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Plan toh hai, next attempt chhe mahine baad hai. Par itne time tak padhai kaise continue karu, motivation khatam ho gayi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Motivation roz nahi aati, habit aati hai. Roz subah do ghante fix kar, baaki time kuch aur kar. Main bhi aise hi nikla tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tu bahut strong hai yaar, main itna sambhal nahi pata. Aaj toh bas ro rahi hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Rona bhi theek hai, main bhi roya tha, usse weak nahi hota. Aaj rone de, kal se kaam shuru.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, aaj mummy papa se baat karunga. Tu mere saath hai toh himmat aa rahi hai. Thanks.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, hamesha. Aur agar lagta hai kuch nahi ho raha, mujhe call kar, main tere saath revision plan bana dunga.

questions.answer_quote: Maine bhi apna pehla attempt miss kiya tha

questions.answer_quote: Rona bhi theek hai

questions.answer_quote: sirf ek din ka bad luck

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rohan, ghar mein aaj bahut badi ladai ho gayi. Bhabhi ne bola ki main ghar ka kaam nahi karta, aur mummy ne uski taraf se baat ki.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Ye toh bahut bura hua. Tu us waqt kahan tha, sab ke saamne hua ya alag?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sab ke saamne, kitchen mein. Main kuch bola nahi, bas chup chap apne kamre mein aa gaya. Andar se bahut gussa aa raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Chup rehna himmat hai, par gussa andar dabana achha nahi. Main bhi ek baar aise hi chup raha tha, phir mera BP high ho gaya tha doctor ne bola stress se.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Sach mein? Tera BP bhi badh gaya tha? Mujhe toh sar bhari bhari lag raha hai, neend bhi nahi aayi raat ko.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Haan, tab maine apne aap se baat ki, likh ke apne gusse ko nikaala. Aur papa ko alag se baith ke samjhaya, ladai ke beech mein nahi.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Mujhe lagta hai bhabhi se baat karni chahiye, par mummy ko bura lagega. Dono ko saath rakhna mushkil hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Dono ko khush karna possible nahi. Pehle bhabhi se alag mil, ek samay fix kar, aur apni baat bina shikayat ke rakh.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Kaise? Main toh baat karte hi hichkichata hoon, gale mein kuch atak jata hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pehle likh ke rakh, phir padh ke bol. Main bhi aise hi practice karta hoon jab kisi se baat karni hoti hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tu bahut samajhdar hai, mujhe yeh idea nahi aaya. Par agar phir bhi na maane toh?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Toh usko time de, ek din mein rishta theek nahi hota. Aur bahut bura ho toh chup rehna, baad mein apne papa se baat kar.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Hmm, kal main bhabhi ke paas jaake baat karunga. Agar nahi bani toh mummy ko bhi samjhaunga.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Sahi hai, par apna khayal rakh, khaana time pe kha. Ghar ki tension mein log apni sehat bhool jate hain.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tu sach mein sahi keh raha hai, aaj se khaana skip nahi karunga. Thank you yaar, tension kam hui.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Kabhi bhi. Aur agar ghar mein phir aisa ho, mujhe raat ko message kar, main sun lunga.

questions.answer_quote: Bhabhi ne bola ki main ghar ka kaam nahi karta

questions.answer_quote: Pehle bhabhi se alag mil, ek samay fix kar

questions.answer_quote: phir mera BP high ho gaya tha

questions.query: BP wali baat Rohan ne kis context mein kahi thi?
questions.answer_quote: phir mera BP high ho gaya tha

questions.query: Ghabrahat door karne ke liye kaunsa tarika suggest kiya gaya?
questions.answer_quote: Pehle likh ke rakh

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Rohan, aaj report aa gayi, doctor ne bola ki ek cyst hai, aur test dobara karana padega. Main bahut dar gayi.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Arre, ghabra mat. Cyst ka matlab turant kuch bura nahi hota, bahut log normal rehte hain. Doctor ne kuch aur bola?

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Usne bola ki size chhota hai, par ek mahine baad phir se scan. Main raat bhar sochti rahi, cancer toh nahi hai na?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Dekh, main apne chacha ke saath yeh sab dekh chuka hoon. Unka bhi aisa hi report aaya tha, aur wo aaj bilkul theek hain, sirf checkup chal raha hai.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tujhe kaise pata chala tha ki tension lena bekaar hai? Main toh har chhoti cheez par ro deti hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Maine ek baar khud ko rok diya tha, internet par symptoms padh ke. Uske baad maine doctor se hi sab poocha, Google se nahi. Wahi sabse badi galti thi meri.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Haan, maine bhi Google kiya tha, aur wahan toh sab cancer likha tha. Ab aur dar lag raha hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Google har bimari ko cancer banata hai, usse door rah. Aaj raat phone side mein rakh, aur kal subah doctor ko call kar ke apna doubt poochh.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Achha, toh dobara test se pehle main kya karu? Khaana theek se nahi kha rahi, bhookh nahi lagti.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Pehle so ja, neend ke bina dar aur badhta hai. Main bhi us waqt poori raat jaagta tha, phir dimaag aur kharab hota tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Tu sach mein samajh raha hai. Mere ghar walon ko abhi batana chahiye ya nahi?

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Jab tak test dobara nahi hota, unhe tension mat de. Report clear aane ke baad bata dena, warna sab pareshan honge.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Theek hai, main wait karungi. Par mujhe roz ek baar himmat dena padega, warna main phir sochne lagti hoon.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Main hoon na, roz message kar dunga. Aur ek cheez, maine apne liye ek diary rakhi thi, roz do line likhta tha, usse dimaag halka hota tha.

messages.speaker: Aditi
messages.content: Diary wala idea achha hai. Chalo, aaj se likhungi. Thank you yaar, tera saath bahut bada sahara hai.

messages.speaker: Rohan
messages.content: Aur haan, khud ko blame mat kar, jo bhi hoga hum saath dekh lenge. Roz message karna.
